title: EIT HEI Call 2026 info session: Open Q&A
summary: Online info session of the EIT Higher Education Initiative Call for Proposals 2026, focused on open questions from applicants.
details: The session runs from 15:00–16:30 CET and is part of the Call 2026 info session series. The call funds consortia led by higher education institutions with up to €1.25 million per project, and the submission deadline is 13 January 2027 at 17:00 CET.
Recordings and slides of earlier sessions are published on the official call page.
why: Useful for universities planning to coordinate a proposal and for companies that want to join one as one of the two required business partners. Attending before drafting helps align the action plan and budget with what evaluators expect.
